scenes.video_prompt:
A realistic single continuous 10-second vertical product demonstration, 9:16, 720x1280. Use image 1 exactly as the starting shot. Same hands, sage-green shirt, lavender power bank and light. Image 2 locks the exact product, image 3 locks the same adult woman if any face becomes visible.
Keep the product CRADLED HORIZONTALLY in the SAME supporting palm, in the SAME diagonal orientation as image 1 for all ten seconds. The black display stays at the LOWER-RIGHT of the visible body, the loop stays at the UPPER-RIGHT, and the same long edge stays nearest the camera. Do not roll it in the picture plane, turn it upright, turn it upside down, flip, change grip or show any other side. Keep the supporting forearm and wrist still. Only a tiny 3-degree side-to-side depth yaw once, which never changes those screen positions. The black window is always glossy solid BLACK with its original tiny white markings, never gray, never blank or glowing. Exactly one short lavender loop, original body proportions and visible side geometry.
Simple action: immediately lift the FREE HAND toward the blank lavender shell; settle for half a second. Around second 2 make the tiny 3-degree depth yaw and stop. From seconds 3 to 6, gently place two fingertips ON the blank upper lavender shell and slowly stroke just 1 cm, then lift them away. Supporting hand and body remain in their original pose. From seconds 6 to 10 keep product steady, only natural hand breathing and one small free-finger gesture beside it. No extra action or handling. Do not touch/cover the black display or loop. Fingers must have believable contact shadows, no fingers through product.
Camera is a LOCKED tripod, same crop as opening: no zoom, no pan, no travel, no face-following, no reframe. Full body and loop always inside frame. Same fixed bright diffuse light throughout with locked exposure/white balance, no darkening, fade, changing shadow or vignette. No speaking or mouth movement, no captions, subtitles, marketing cards, added text or watermark. Keep only original physical product markings. No audio, music or voice. No cuts, repeated or frozen frames.
scenes.action_timeline: Free hand moves immediately; brief settling; tiny 3-degree depth yaw, same palm/grip; fingers actually stroke blank shell around 3–6s then release. Maintain original diagonal product pose, black window and short single loop.
